preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of bus routes m is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of questions q is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == -1 if not possible(v, u) else min_buses(v, u)
postconditions.description: For each question, the output is -1 if it is not possible to get from city v to city u, otherwise it is the minimum number of buses needed.
